candidates.comment: Thanks for the report. https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/323732 already tracks adding Fork Conversation at the end of the chat. Your suggestion to place it in the response footer, and the workaround of sending a no-op message before forking, describe the same missing affordance.

Thanks for the detailed investigation. The same garbled Windows 11 context-menu entry is tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/300659. Consolidating there, with this report preserving the zh-CN/ACP 936 environment, DLL and CLSID identification, correct UTF-16 registry value, and disappearing entry when the title is changed to ASCII.

Thanks for the report and the minimal reproduction. This is the same custom-filesystem inline-suggestion regression tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/335774. This thread adds Zowe and ObjectScript confirmations, a minimal TypeScript filesystem-provider reproduction, and confirmation that disabling `github.copilot.chat.advanced.inlineEdits.unification` and reloading restores suggestions; those details are useful evidence for the shared fix.

Thanks for the report. The same locked `chat.sessionSync.enabled` setting and misleading organization message for personal accounts are tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/320335. Your Fedora 44 / 1.131.0-insider reproduction, including persistence with extensions disabled, adds useful platform evidence to that investigation.

Thanks for the feedback. The request to retain the previous, space-efficient interface is already tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/326146. Consolidating there also keeps this thread's concerns about rounded tabs, panel gaps, tab clarity, and screen-edge interaction together.

For now, setting `workbench.experimental.modernUI` to `false` restores the Classic UI; this is a temporary option, not a resolution of the request to retain it permanently.

Thanks for the request. https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/321372 tracks the same capability, including custom thinking parameters. Consolidating there preserves the `thinking.type` use case; https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/329215 is an open implementation candidate.

Thanks for the report. Cross-workspace chat history is tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/334228. This report adds the specific case where an empty window omits workspace chats despite the documented expectation, making older chats difficult to find when workspaces are ephemeral.

Thanks for the report and follow-up traces. This is the same deprecated request/proxy parsing tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/301941, with a fix proposed in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/302334. This thread adds Windows and macOS reproductions for extension updates and installation by identifier, plus downstream automation impact; those cases should be retained when reviewing the fix.

Thanks for the report and the version confirmations. This matches https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/280824, which tracks todos remaining unchecked even after Copilot finishes the work. This thread adds the Plan-to-implementation trigger, the manual-update workaround, and confirmations through VS Code 1.144.1.

Thanks for the report. The same unbounded webview cache growth is tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/320928, including repeated image previews and missing cache eviction. Consolidating there should preserve this report's Windows Remote-SSH reproduction with approximately 20 MB images, along with the later Linux evidence of cache accumulation across extension updates. This does not mean the problem is fixed.

Thanks for the report. The same restart/configuration-refresh failure is tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/265649. This report adds a VS Code 1.115.0 Dev Container reproduction with a wizard-created Bazel server that initially fails; correcting its command and arguments takes effect only after reloading the window.

Thanks for the report. This matches https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/296643, which tracks the model picker appearing at the top-left corner when Other Models is clicked. The additional reproduction detail here is to reopen Insiders and click Other Models as soon as the picker becomes available.

Thanks for the report. This matches the global-menu regression tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/283522, including reports that native title bars do not restore the menu. This thread adds confirmations on Fedora 43, Kubuntu 26.04, and Arch with Plasma 6.6.3–6.6.5, and notes that the older workaround in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/34510 did not help.

Thanks for the report and setup log. The log shows `Add-AppxPackage` failing with result code 1, matching the registration failure tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/303103. Consolidating there, with this log and the later observations about repeated updates and user-versus-system setup retained as supporting evidence.

Thanks for the report and configuration examples. Azure-provider support for Foundry-hosted Claude endpoints is already tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/294841, including the same URL error. This thread also adds a reported working alternative: in `chatLanguageModels.json`, use `vendor: "customendpoint"` with `apiType: "messages"` and the Foundry `/anthropic` base URL, as shown above; that does not resolve the Azure-provider support request.

Thanks for the request. This is already tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/137344: checking for updates should allow a separate decision to download. Carrying forward this thread's requirement that checking work without downloading on ordinary connections too, along with the reported macOS metered-setting limitation.
